gen-eater-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks bent from a single length of tubing, with small letters nearly as tall as the capitals and a visible gap at each c. Eater's spiky, thin-and-thick menace sits above it, and the sans then reads smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-lexend-peta: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors stacks diagonals as heavy as its stems under a towering x-height. And Lexend Peta follows with curves that never thin, a plain sans with a wide-mouthed c.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-lexend-zetta: Expressive spaghetti-like strokes give Funnel Display its commanding look, with c tips that stay well apart. Funnel Display is the showpiece; Lexend Zetta's widely tracked ribbon strokes do the plain sans work.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-montserrat-altern: Grandstander's short ascenders and tall x-height give it a bold, held-open look in lines of constant width. Montserrat Alternates follows with round letters and an open c, though the heading loses punch if it is made small.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga draws flat, single-weight lines with generous tracking, so each word gets room in a modern, professional voice. Goldman's wide, parenthesis-round forms above it supply the commanding quality.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-julius-s: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height, with terminals pointing outward in a level, quiet beat. Julius Sans One then adds wide blank gaps between letters and open curves, so the sans lets that bold heading breathe.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend-mega: Tall, stubborn lowercase, nearly capital height, runs through Gugi, whose cut-open terminals let the counters flow outward. Lexend Mega, a plain sans drawn with one nib, keeps long text approachable.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-lexend-g: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister holds its ascenders barely above the x-height with outward-pointing terminals. And Lexend Giga's flat, generously tracked sans-serif lines would keep a long passage modern and orderly.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-kadwa: Bold and tall in the lowercase, New Title locks its letters together like links in a fine chain. But Kadwa, a classic serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height, handles the steady reading.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-merriweather: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with tall lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Early GameBoy does the playful shouting; the sans does the talking.
